attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Refactors query-string ordering (format before quality) across multiple media URL-building paths (filters, formatter, shortcodes, profiles), which could change generated media URLs and thus cache keys/CDN caching for existing sites relying on the old parameter order, though behavior is covered by new unit tests and logic appears equivalent otherwise."}

reason: Refactors query-string ordering (format before quality) across multiple media URL-building paths (filters, formatter, shortcodes, profiles), which could change generated media URLs and thus cache keys/CDN caching for existing sites relying on the old parameter order, though behavior is covered by new unit tests and logic appears equivalent otherwise.
